title: Special Financing on the Card Purchase — Finch Circle Late Credit Share
content:
**Clause.** In a late credit of Finch Circle Loyalty Program points on a missing-points request, the late-credit financing share is 0 when the card purchase charged for the unit's order carries an 18-month deferred interest plan, one half (0.5) when it carries a 12-month deferred interest plan, and the whole (1) when it carries no special financing plan.

The plan is read from the card purchase booked for the unit's order number on the card account, among the account transactions kept under Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards; it is the promotional financing plan that card purchase carries.

## Plan and share

| Special financing plan on the card purchase for the unit's order | Late-credit financing share |
|---|---|
| 18-month deferred interest | 0 |
| 12-month deferred interest | 0.5 |
| No special financing plan | 1 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A sofa order charged as a card purchase with 12-month deferred interest: share one half.
- A coat charged as a card purchase with no promotional plan: share the whole.
- A mattress order charged with 18-month deferred interest: share 0.
